topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I was scrolling through the familiar glow, when suddenly, there it was—words that shook the quiet of my evening. This friend, whose laughter I've only heard through the static of speakers, whose stories I've pieced together like a mosaic from thousands of miles away, speaks of spaces I know. They see the same sunsets, walk the same streets. It’s as if a distant star has unexpectedly appeared in my own night sky, casting a light I hadn’t anticipated. Now, the air is different, charged with the possibility of these new paths converging.
